changes.editSummary: Rewrote Bryan Johnson sauna why-it-works copy around high-dose dry heat, core-temperature targeting, heat-acclimation, workout stacking, and groin-cooling mechanics.

changes.editSummary: Separated the Bryan Johnson sauna routine into source-attributed steps, tips, logging fields, and interpretation notes, with a clearer why-it-works section.

changes.editSummary: Added findings paragraphs to the Bryan Johnson sauna source pages so each cited artifact explains what the source reports and how cautiously to read it.
changes.rationale: The experiment detail research section needs source-level finding copy rather than placeholder provenance text, especially for self-reported social and web sources that should not be treated as general causal evidence.

changes.editSummary: Added the dry-sauna research landscape and protocol-scoped evidence appraisals for the second batch of Finnish dry-sauna reports.
changes.rationale: The grouped research UI needs protocol-specific interpretation so the later sauna corpus reports read as support, mixed evidence, safety boundary, or context instead of a flat source inventory.

changes.editSummary: Rewrote Finnish dry-sauna why-it-works copy around acute heat load, heat-acclimation, vascular, and autonomic rebound mechanisms.
changes.rationale: The section should answer why a short dry-sauna self-test might change near-term signals, not restate evidence posture or protocol caveats.

changes.editSummary: Separated Finnish dry-sauna steps from tips, logging fields, and interpretation notes, and rewrote the mechanism-focused why-it-works copy.
changes.rationale: The experiment detail page should show a short how-to protocol first, then practical context and evidence caveats separately so users are not forced to parse setup facts, tips, and disclaimers as numbered steps.

changes.editSummary: Added research-landscape groups and protocol-specific appraisal metadata for the first 47 Finnish dry-sauna source reports.
changes.rationale: The sauna page should explain which sources support the self-test rationale, which are acute physiology, which are long-term context, and which mainly set safety or confounder boundaries without making users infer that from titles alone.

changes.editSummary: Added missing Finnish dry-sauna source pages and corrected ambiguous source metadata, including the stroke-cohort PMID mismatch, acute vascular null evidence, post-exercise context, classic thermoregulation and fluid-balance references, and modality guardrails.
changes.rationale: The Finnish dry-sauna protocol should cite the exact primary and review records used for claims while separating long-term cohort rationale, acute physiology, short-term experiment design, and modality or safety caveats without copying stale corpus totals from an older sauna snapshot.

changes.editSummary: Rewrote Norwegian 4x4 why-it-works copy around sustained high oxygen demand, active-recovery dose design, central and peripheral VO2max adaptations, and recovery-stress signals.
changes.rationale: The section should explain the training physiology behind four-minute aerobic intervals rather than mainly summarizing the evidence base.

changes.editSummary: Added the Norwegian 4x4 bounded self-experiment protocol, source pages, bibliography, artifact manifest, and open-access artifact downloader helper.
changes.rationale: Convert the prepared Norwegian 4x4 research landing into Health Commons pages with strict overclaim guardrails, variant separation, and a repo-native PDF workflow that downloads only manifest-approved open-access artifacts.

changes.editSummary: Separated Norwegian 4x4 execution steps from tips, logging fields, and interpretation notes, and rewrote why-it-works around aerobic interval mechanism.
changes.rationale: The protocol should read as a concise workout recipe with separate context for HR targeting, proxy VO2max interpretation, recovery stress, and adjacent interval variants.

changes.editSummary: Grouped the Norwegian 4x4 research section into protocol-support, mixed clinical-superiority, safety-boundary, and adjacent-context categories, and added protocol-specific appraisal metadata to every displayed Norwegian 4x4 source.
changes.rationale: The experiment page should explain what the evidence supports, what is mixed, what is safety-only, and what is adjacent without forcing users to infer that from paper titles and counts.

changes.editSummary: Expanded the Norwegian 4x4 research section with missing 4x4-lineage clinical trials, direct 4HIIT-vs-1HIIT evidence, and clinical synthesis sources.
changes.rationale: The prior corpus had the canonical healthy-adult trial, public protocol page, safety context, and later mixed clinical trials, but underrepresented the early CAD, HFrEF, metabolic-syndrome, adolescent, CABG, hypertension, and 4HIIT-vs-1HIIT papers that explain why Norwegian 4x4 needs explicit population-mismatch and variant-separation guardrails.

changes.editSummary: Rewrote red-light-glasses why-it-works copy around melanopsin retinal signaling, circadian-clock input, melatonin and alerting physiology, spectral filtering quality, and downstream wearable effects.
changes.rationale: The section should explain the proposed light-to-circadian mechanism directly without foregrounding broad evidence caveats.

changes.editSummary: Deduped the pass-4 red-light-glasses package into the existing landing by adding adjacent source pages and expanding artifact coverage without replaying the full reland.
changes.rationale: The pass-4 package carried additional adjacent-variant, home-lighting, and claim-calibration sources plus clearer open-access artifact targets, but most page bodies had already landed in the earlier patch.

changes.editSummary: Separated red-light-glasses steps from tips, logging fields, and interpretation notes, and rewrote why-it-works around evening melanopic-light reduction.
changes.rationale: The page should make the nightly test easy to follow while preserving the compiled evidence caveats around mixed objective sleep outcomes, lens quality, daytime light, and safety-critical tasks.

changes.editSummary: Grouped the red-light glasses before bed research section into direct adult sleep evidence, mechanism and implementation evidence, measurement/claim guardrails, and adjacent clinical variants, and added protocol-specific appraisal metadata to every displayed source.
changes.rationale: The experiment page should show why the protocol is plausible, why direct objective sleep evidence remains mixed, which claims are out of scope, and which clinical or special-population literatures should stay separate.

changes.editSummary: Materialized the full 81-record Finnish dry-sauna yes/likely bibliography subset into source pages and linked it to the canonical Finnish dry-sauna protocol.
changes.rationale: The product page should not look like a 6-paper sauna page when the audited workbook already supports a larger Finnish dry-sauna corpus; the detail transformer now counts and renders direct study source pages instead of clipping the list to six cards.

changes.editSummary: Added supplemental sauna research source pages for fertility, thermal-dose, extreme-heat safety, vascular, passive-heat synthesis, and sweat/detox-claim caveats while keeping Bryan Johnson protocol citations limited to Bryan/Blueprint source posts.
changes.rationale: Independent sauna literature belongs on the broader sauna and dry-sauna evidence graph; Bryan Johnson's protocol page should remain a source-attributed external routine rather than a mixed general-literature review.

changes.editSummary: Added structured experimentOnboarding data for the Bryan Johnson Blueprint sauna protocol, including safety screening, setup slots, read hints, logging fields, and assistant reminder policy.
changes.rationale: Murph needs protocol-specific onboarding data so the assistant can safely distinguish the external source routine from a user-confirmed run plan before creating an experiment or reminders.

changes.editSummary: Expanded the Bryan Johnson sauna research section beyond source attribution with independent sauna physiology, long-term cohort, post-exercise, fertility, and safety evidence groups.
changes.rationale: The prior research section was readable but sparse and over-dependent on Bryan Johnson / Blueprint self-reports; the experiment page should separate exact source provenance from independent mechanism context, adjacent intervention findings, and safety boundaries.

changes.editSummary: Reorganized the Norwegian 4x4 research section into exact-dose, dose-fidelity, broader-context, clinical, safety, and adjacent-variant layers while tightening source metadata and making the experiment-page cards easier to scan.
changes.rationale: The prior page mixed exact 4x4 trials, how-to sources, pooled HIIT context, and cardiac-rehab boundary papers too closely; average health-conscious users need the direct evidence first and the larger-context guardrails clearly labeled.

changes.editSummary: Added a publishable Blood Glucose biomarker page with diagnostic boundaries, monitoring/device guardrails, hypoglycemia safety language, protocol rankings, and source-backed claims.
changes.rationale: Murph needs a glucose page that separates clinical diagnosis from personal tracking, surfaces method and timing context, and can read imported glucose samples in the private browser-vault biomarker trend card.

changes.editSummary: Seeded a REM sleep minutes biomarker page with wearable REM interpretation guidance, private metric bindings, protocol ranking, community-outcome placeholder, and source-backed measurement caveats.
changes.rationale: REM sleep appears in wearable sleep dashboards and Murph sleep experiments, but it needs conservative, source-backed interpretation because PSG-defined REM is biologically real while consumer REM-stage estimates are noisy.
